what: blaze_link::fuzz_read (lib.rs:636) builds an Output (two Strings, a Vec) and a model::writer(&output) for every read, and the 13 fuzz/targets/link_* targets call it 2 to 3 times a run (now one arch and one compared read a run, was 4 to 6). Most fuzz inputs are a few hundred bytes, so the writer setup may be most of a read. Please measure fuzz_read on a 256-byte refused input with the writer setup and without; if the setup is over 10% of it, give the fuzz feature a reader made once per (format, arch), e.g. `pub struct FuzzReader` with `fn new(format, arch) -> FuzzReader` and `fn read(&mut self, kind, bytes) -> bool`, each read starting from the same state as a fresh writer (so a target can hold one in a thread_local, deterministic per input). Tell the owner of fuzz/ which you did.
